notes.title: Pixel Sentry Released
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Yesterday we released the game Pixel Sentry on steam at 18:00 Central European Time. 

After many hours of playtesting, programming and creating art, the game is complete. We hope you will enjoy finding new and interesting item combinations as much as we do. There are over 50 items in the game, with each item to some degree interacting with the other items. Even getting the same item twice could yield a new and interesting combination. 

[b]To celebrate this we will be running a special deal.[/b] Anyone who buys the game, and joins are discord server will be part of a lottery. The winners will be allowed to make one item in-game (with our help of course) where they can choose everything about it (within reason). 

In the future, we hope to add new content, and we would love to hear any thought you have. So if you want to affect the future of the game, you may do so on our discord server: [url=]https://discord.gg/tFHJGDn[/url]

Things we are looking to add in the future:
[list]
[*] More items
[*] More enemies and levels
[*] Mac support
[*] Steam cloud support
[*] More achievements
[/list]

See you in space!
Reborb Studios
